notes: §1985:VIII.3.2.3 SR3 (relative I-O): "One or more record description entries must follow the file description entry." BindFileSection calls MaterializeImpliedRecord for an FD with no level-01 record; below DialectLevel 2002 it reports COBOL1837 citing §1985:VIII.3.2.3 SR3 for FileOrganization.Relative before the 2002 permission (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR3) is reached. Witness: a relative FD with RECORD CONTAINS 10 and no record is refused at 85 (accepted at 2023). Probes at 85: (e) record-less relative FD at ACCESS SEQUENTIAL, RANDOM and DYNAMIC each refused with COBOL1837 VIII; a relative FD with two 01 records at DYNAMIC wrote and read key 2 and printed 'ABCDE'; (b) a record-less relative FD beside a record-less indexed FD reports each (VIII and IX); (c) at 2002 the record-less relative FD with RECORD CONTAINS is accepted while indexed stays refused (SR7). Read 6 (2026-11-14, records-read6): the row had no verdict and no test-ref although its witness existed; the reader read CONFORMS and an independent refuter UPHELD it (op-20261114/out-read6/rd-NN.json and rd-NN-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985 VIII.3.2.3 SR3 (relative I-O): 'One or more record description entries must follow the file description entry.' 2023 brackets the record-description-entry group after file-description-entry in §2023:13.4.2; §2023:13.4.5.3 SR7 requires record descriptions only 'For an indexed file'; §2023:13.4.5.3 SR3 and §2023:13.18.43.3 SR1 let a relative FD have none when a RECORD clause is given, WRITE/REWRITE use the FILE and FROM phrases and READ uses INTO. A relative FD without record descriptions, refused in 1985, is accepted: a compile-time relaxation, no exception condition.
